title: UN/LOCODE-paikkakoodit — Suomi (satamat, lentoasemat, terminaalit)
description: Täydellinen luettelo Suomen UN/LOCODE-paikkakoodeista. All 780 UN/LOCODE entries for Finland from the UNECE United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations: LOCODE, place name (with and without diacritics), subdivision, function classifiers (sea port, rail, road, airport, postal, multimodal), approval status, IATA code and coordinates. Function legend embedded per record; status codes per UNECE status-indicators table. Note: Finland is bilingual — the official UNECE list carries separate rows per language name variant (e.g. Helsinki/Helsingfors, Espoo/Esbo), so 70 LOCODEs appear twice with Finnish and Swedish names; both rows are preserved verbatim from the source.

meta.title: UN/LOCODE-paikkakoodit — Suomi (satamat, lentoasemat, terminaalit) - Ilmainen lataus
meta.description: Täydellinen luettelo Suomen UN/LOCODE-paikkakoodeista. All 780 UN/LOCODE entries for Finland from the UNECE United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations: LOCODE, place name (with and without diacritics), subdivision, function classifiers (sea port, rail, road, airport, postal, multimodal), approval status, IATA code and coordinates. Function legend embedded per record; status codes per UNECE status-indicators table. Note: Finland is bilingual — the official UNECE list carries separate rows per language name variant (e.g. Helsinki/Helsingfors, Espoo/Esbo), so 70 LOCODEs appear twice with Finnish and Swedish names; both rows are preserved verbatim from the source. Sisältää 780 tietuetta. Lataa Excel, CSV, PDF muodoissa.
